nodes.name: Lemma 1
nodes.statement:
If ${\lambda} \leq c_{\min}^2/ (10 sc_{\max})$
   and $\lVert X^\top\varepsilon/n\rVert_{\infty} \leq {\lambda}/4$,
    then
  \[
  \lVert{\hat{\alpha}_{S}}-{\beta^*_{S}}\rVert_2\leq \frac{5{\lambda} \surd{s}}{c_{\min}}\,.
  \]

nodes.name: Lemma 3
Lemma 2
nodes.statement:
If $\lambda \leq \gamma c_{\min}^2/(100(2-\gamma)sc_{\max})$ and $\lVert X^\top \varepsilon/n\rVert_{\infty} \leq {\lambda}/4$, then
  \[
  \lVert X^\top r/n\rVert_{\infty}\leq \frac{{\lambda} \gamma}{4(2-\gamma)}\,.
  \]

nodes.name: Theorem 1
Theorem 2
nodes.statement:
Under Assumption~1 and 2, for any $\delta\in (0,1)$ and $C\geq 1.5 a/c_{\min}$, the tuning parameter~$\hat{{\lambda}}$ from  (4) provides with probability at least $1-\delta$
 \[\hat{{\lambda}}\leq {\lambda}_{\delta}^* \quad \text{and} \quad
 \lVert{\hat{\beta}}_{\hat{{\lambda}}}-{\beta^*}\rVert_{\infty}\leq 3C{\lambda}_{\delta}^*\,,
\]
and, if $\min_{j \in S}|{\beta^*_j}|>6C{\lambda}_{\delta}^*,$
     \begin{equation*}
       \hat S \supset S\,.
     \end{equation*}
